Hi, I'm Gabriel Turinici, math university professor in Paris and interested in lean formalization. My main domain is numerical computations and AI/ML in general with applications to diverse fields such as medicine, finance, quantum physics, AI agents and so on. For my work I often see half-rigorous proofs that require substantial time investment so I really appreciate the effort this community is doing to formalize math and help us all agree on math statements.

In my work I noticed some spots not yet covered in Mathlib and been starting to formalize, go to #PR reviews channel for details.

best regards,
Gabriel

my github channel
my google scholar for research interests
